headline: Paladin Energy Raises $353 Million via Discounted Share Placement
summary: Uranium miner Paladin Energy raised US$353 million in an equity offering priced at a 10.3% discount, allocating the proceeds to debt repayment, exploration, and Canadian development assets.
why: Paladin operates the Langer Heinrich mine in Namibia and is expanding globally as nuclear energy demand drives long-term uranium procurement.

impacts.name: Paladin Energy
impacts.why: New shares issued at a 10.3% discount create dilution for existing equity holders.
